items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 46:1
items.html: For when the records were close to them, in the discernment of crownlets [tagin] on the letters, in the place of NHYM of Atzilut, they were able to sustain themselves within GAR of BYA, since they too were a discernment of GAR of ZAT. But after the records grew distant and clothed in the new vessels and in the Rosh of Yeshsut, their illumination from the vessels ceased, and therefore they fell to the lowest floor of BYA, which is the place of NHYM of BYA. (p. 556, Item 25)
